related.title: LAMMPS：鄰居清單 skin 與重建安全
related.titleEn: LAMMPS: neighbor skins and rebuild checks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付樹節點幾何、開角判定與直接求和驗證；.2接受、.4展開，報告另有直接力參考與誤差定義；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver tree geometry, opening decisions, and direct-sum validation. Accept 0.2 and open 0.4. Include an independent direct-force reference and explicit error definition. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫力截距、鄰居截距和兩粒子相向移動，記位置更新前後與清單建立時刻；10/15可重算，記相對位移理由且不把安全邊界當建議最大性能設定。
related.differenceEn: Draw force and neighbor cutoffs with two approaching particles. Record position updates and the list construction time. Reproduce 10 and 15 with the relative-motion rationale. Do not present the boundary as an optimized production setting.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化接受量s/d，若s/d<θ才以群集近似；此幾何條件不直接等於力誤差；合成群寬s2、距離d10，θ.25；變更d5，保持s與θ；名義式 2/10 = 0.2 opening ratio；變更式 2/5 = 0.4 opening ratio。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

保守教學判準為每粒子移動不超skin/2，因兩粒子可能相向；不是所有設定的唯一重建規則；合成skin=.4距離單位，速度上限.02單位/步；改skin=.6，速度固定；名義式 (.4/2)/.02 = 10 steps to half-skin displacement；變更式 (.6/2)/.02 = 15 steps to half-skin displacement。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The simplified rule accepts a group when s/d < θ. This geometric ratio is not a direct bound on force error. Synthetic group size s = 2, distance d = 10, θ = 0.25; compare d = 5 with fixed s and θ. Nominal 2/10 = 0.2 opening ratio; changed 2/5 = 0.4 opening ratio. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

A conservative teaching criterion limits each particle to half the skin because two particles can approach each other. Actual policies have additional conditions. Synthetic skin = 0.4 distance units and maximum motion = 0.02 units per step; compare skin = 0.6 at the same motion rate. Nominal (.4/2)/.02 = 10 steps to half-skin displacement; changed (.6/2)/.02 = 15 steps to half-skin displacement. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Kokkos View：記憶體布局與存取跨度
related.titleEn: Kokkos View: memory layouts and access strides
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付樹節點幾何、開角判定與直接求和驗證；.2接受、.4展開，報告另有直接力參考與誤差定義；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver tree geometry, opening decisions, and direct-sum validation. Accept 0.2 and open 0.4. Include an independent direct-force reference and explicit error definition. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫3×4矩陣，依行與依列各寫線性索引；標連續j和連續i的工作分配；48/56正確，所有12邏輯元素保持相同且地址不越界。
related.differenceEn: Draw all 3×4 indices in row and column order. Map work across consecutive i or j values. Verify offsets 48 and 56 with all 12 logical elements unchanged and in bounds.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化接受量s/d，若s/d<θ才以群集近似；此幾何條件不直接等於力誤差；合成群寬s2、距離d10，θ.25；變更d5，保持s與θ；名義式 2/10 = 0.2 opening ratio；變更式 2/5 = 0.4 opening ratio。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
row-major偏移i×C+j，column-major偏移j×R+i；同一邏輯矩陣可有不同實體跨度；合成R3、C4，元素(i1,j2)，每元素8bytes；求兩布局byte offset；名義式 (1*4+2)*8 = 48 byte offset；變更式 (2*3+1)*8 = 56 byte offset。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The simplified rule accepts a group when s/d < θ. This geometric ratio is not a direct bound on force error. Synthetic group size s = 2, distance d = 10, θ = 0.25; compare d = 5 with fixed s and θ. Nominal 2/10 = 0.2 opening ratio; changed 2/5 = 0.4 opening ratio. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Row-major offset is iC+j; column-major offset is jR+i. The same logical matrix can have different physical strides. Synthetic R = 3, C = 4, index (1, 2), and 8 bytes per element. Calculate both byte offsets. Nominal (1*4+2)*8 = 48 byte offset; changed (2*3+1)*8 = 56 byte offset. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
